nodes.label: Five-Model Local MLX Sweep
nodes.rationale: Twenty-five rows cover five local 4-bit models across intent, dialogue, reaction, Tier 2, and Tier 3 slices. OLMo 7B reached dialogue 4.78 at 4.59 GB; EXAONE timed out at roughly 1,800 seconds per slice; several models produced high dialogue scores but pending simulation judgments.

edges.source_location: /rows entries appear in the local leaderboard table
